title: Google Reports Increased Search Growth from AI Investments
excerpt: Alphabet's Q3 2026 earnings reveal that Google's investments in artificial intelligence are boosting overall search queries.
body_html:
Google parent company Alphabet announced its Q3 2026 earnings, reporting that artificial intelligence investments are contributing to significant year-over-year growth in search activity.

Growth in Queries

According to Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai, the company's focus on AI is expanding overall search query volumes, which includes commercial queries. Pichai stated that the year-over-year query growth rate has reached its highest level recently.
